verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop is officially certified on Raspberry Pi and marketed as delivering 'a rich developer experience on this powerful Arm device,' directly supporting the SBC dev-experience story, but this is a single vendor claim with no independent hands-on corroboration of performance, tooling compatibility, or IDE/AI-ML workloads specifically on SBC hardware. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of the Raspberry Pi developer experience, details on performance limitations of low-cost SBCs, and coverage of other SBC platforms beyond Raspberry Pi.
